capstone.title: Secure a Company: Design Review and Hardening
capstone.desc: Multi-step simulated engagement: threat model the architecture, fix IAM, network, cloud and pipeline findings, set up detection, then present a prioritized roadmap.

cert_note: Overlaps CISSP domains 3, 4, 5, 8; AWS Security Specialty; CKS topics. Study guide only, not an official prep.

can_do: Decompose a system into a data flow diagram with trust boundaries
Apply STRIDE and attack trees to rank threats and pick mitigations
Design layered controls using zero trust and defense in depth

lessons.title: Threat modeling process and DFDs
lessons.goal: Explain the four-question threat modeling process and draw a DFD with its core element types.

lessons.title: Trust boundaries and attack surface
lessons.goal: Identify trust boundaries and entry points in a DFD and explain why data crossing them needs validation.

lessons.title: STRIDE per element
lessons.goal: Map each STRIDE category to the security property it violates and to typical mitigations per DFD element type.

lessons.title: PASTA and attack trees
lessons.goal: Describe the seven PASTA stages and build an attack tree with AND/OR nodes and leaf-level cost or likelihood.

lessons.title: Secure design patterns and principles
lessons.goal: Apply least privilege, fail-safe defaults, complete mediation and separation of duties to a design.

lessons.title: Zero trust and defense in depth
lessons.goal: Explain NIST SP 800-207 zero trust tenets and place layered controls across network, host, app and data.

labs.title: Draw the DFD
labs.task: Place processes, stores and entities for a web app, connect flows and mark the trust boundaries.

labs.title: STRIDE a login flow
labs.task: For each element of a login DFD, choose the applicable STRIDE threats and a matching mitigation.

labs.title: Build an attack tree
labs.task: Arrange AND/OR nodes to reach the goal 'steal customer data' and mark the cheapest path.

labs.title: Layer the defenses
labs.task: Assign controls to network, host, app and data layers so no single failure exposes the asset.

checkpoint.focus: STRIDE mapping, trust boundaries, attack trees, secure design principles, zero trust tenets

can_do: Apply CIS Benchmark controls to Linux and Windows systems
Build a patch and configuration management workflow with baselines
Detect configuration drift against a hardened baseline

lessons.title: Hardening principles and CIS Benchmarks
lessons.goal: Explain attack surface reduction, CIS Level 1 versus Level 2 profiles and how benchmarks are scored.

lessons.title: Linux hardening
lessons.goal: Harden SSH (PermitRootLogin, key auth), sysctl, file permissions, auditd, and remove unneeded services.

lessons.title: Windows hardening
lessons.goal: Apply Group Policy, local security policy, Defender, BitLocker and disabling SMBv1/LLMNR/NTLM where possible.

lessons.title: Patch management lifecycle
lessons.goal: Describe inventory, test, staged rollout, rollback and emergency patching with WSUS, apt/yum and Intune.

lessons.title: Configuration management tools
lessons.goal: Use Ansible, Puppet or DSC to enforce idempotent desired-state configuration at scale.

lessons.title: Baselines, drift and compliance scanning
lessons.goal: Create gold images, scan with OpenSCAP or Lynis, and handle drift and documented exceptions.

labs.title: Harden sshd_config
labs.task: Edit an sshd_config to disable root login and password auth, set ciphers, and restrict users.

labs.title: Audit a Linux host
labs.task: Run Lynis-style checks, read the findings and fix the failing permission and service items.

labs.title: Windows GPO review
labs.task: Toggle policy settings to meet a baseline: SMBv1 off, NTLM restricted, audit policy set.

labs.title: Patch rollout plan
labs.task: Order systems into rings, choose test and rollback steps, and handle an emergency out-of-band patch.

checkpoint.focus: CIS benchmark profiles, SSH and Windows policy settings, patch lifecycle, config management, drift

can_do: Configure SSO using SAML and OIDC and read their tokens
Design MFA, PAM and service account controls
Store and rotate secrets without hardcoding them

lessons.title: Directory services and AD architecture
lessons.goal: Explain LDAP, Kerberos, Active Directory domains, OUs, groups and tiered administration.

lessons.title: AuthN, AuthZ and access models
lessons.goal: Distinguish RBAC, ABAC and ReBAC, and apply least privilege and joiner-mover-leaver processes.

lessons.title: SAML federation
lessons.goal: Trace a SAML SP-initiated flow and check assertions, signatures, audience and NotOnOrAfter.

lessons.title: OAuth 2.0 and OIDC
lessons.goal: Use authorization code with PKCE and validate ID token claims (iss, aud, exp, nonce) and scopes.

lessons.title: MFA rollout
lessons.goal: Compare TOTP, push and FIDO2/WebAuthn, plan phased enrollment, recovery, and mitigate MFA fatigue.

lessons.title: Privileged access management
lessons.goal: Implement vaulting, just-in-time elevation, session recording and break-glass accounts.

lessons.title: Service accounts and secrets
lessons.goal: Replace static credentials with managed identities, short-lived tokens and Vault-style rotation.

labs.title: Decode a SAML assertion
labs.task: Inspect an intercepted SAML response and spot the missing signature check and wrong audience.

labs.title: Inspect an OIDC token
labs.task: Decode a JWT, verify claims and fix a validation bug that accepts alg none.

labs.title: MFA rollout plan
labs.task: Choose factors per user group, set enrollment order and a safe recovery process.

labs.title: Audit AD groups
labs.task: Browse group memberships, find stale admins and nested privilege paths, and flag them.

labs.title: Remove hardcoded secrets
labs.task: Replace credentials in a script with environment-injected secrets and a Vault lookup.

checkpoint.focus: SAML versus OIDC flows, token validation, MFA types, PAM, service account and secret handling

can_do: Design firewall rules and segmented network zones
Choose VPN, ZTNA, WAF and NAC controls for a given need
Defend DNS and absorb DDoS attacks

lessons.title: Network segmentation and zones

lessons.title: Microsegmentation
lessons.goal: Apply host- and workload-level policy to limit east-west movement using tags and identity.

lessons.title: VPN and ZTNA

lessons.title: WAF and reverse proxies

lessons.title: DNS security and DDoS defense
lessons.goal: Use DNSSEC, DoT/DoH, RPZ, rate limiting, anycast, scrubbing and SYN cookies.

lessons.title: Network access control

labs.title: Write firewall rules
labs.task: Build an ordered rule set for a three-tier app with default deny and least-open ports.

labs.title: Segment the network
labs.task: Place zones and firewalls on a diagram and mark allowed flows between them.

labs.title: Tune a WAF
labs.task: Read WAF blocks, separate real attacks from false positives, and write exclusions.

labs.title: Spot DNS abuse
labs.task: Find DNS tunneling and a spoofed response in a capture and propose DNS controls.

labs.title: Pick the right access control
labs.task: Given five remote-access requirements, choose between VPN, ZTNA and NAC with reasons.

checkpoint.focus: Rule ordering, segmentation design, VPN versus ZTNA, WAF tuning, DNS and DDoS controls, 802.1X

can_do: Configure TLS securely and manage certificate lifecycles
Design key management with KMS, HSM and rotation
Identify and fix common cryptographic implementation mistakes

lessons.title: TLS configuration
lessons.goal: Choose TLS 1.2/1.3, AEAD cipher suites, forward secrecy, HSTS and test with testssl.sh.

lessons.goal: Explain chains, CAs, ACME, OCSP stapling, CT logs and automated renewal to avoid expiry outages.

lessons.title: KMS and envelope encryption
lessons.goal: Use a KMS with data keys, key policies, and separation of key and data access.

lessons.title: HSMs and key rotation
lessons.goal: Compare HSM, FIPS 140-3 levels and rotation, escrow and destruction procedures.

lessons.title: Secrets management
lessons.goal: Operate Vault or cloud secrets managers with dynamic secrets, leases and audit logging.

lessons.title: Common implementation mistakes
lessons.goal: Spot ECB mode, nonce reuse, weak password hashing, hardcoded keys and unsafe randomness, and fix them.

labs.task: Edit an nginx TLS block to disable old protocols and weak ciphers and enable HSTS.

labs.title: Triage an expired cert
labs.task: Use openssl s_client to find the expired intermediate and plan the renewal.

labs.title: Envelope encryption flow
labs.task: Order the steps of data key generation, encryption, wrapping and storage.

labs.title: Review crypto code
labs.task: Find and replace MD5, ECB and a static IV in a code sample with safe alternatives.

checkpoint.focus: TLS settings, certificate lifecycle and ACME, KMS and envelope encryption, rotation, crypto misuse

lessons.title: Security champions program

can_do: Find and fix weaknesses in CI/CD pipelines

labs.title: Verify a signature

labs.title: Read an SBOM
